What is actually needed is for insn 30 to win T-44 and insn 25 to win T-45.

frontier.hypothesis: If the permuter and the priority axis both measure dead, this is a sched.c:2464 tie wall and needs the line-level closure argument written out before any exhaustion claim.
frontier.mechanism: [[sched-rank-class-tie-wall]] - equal priority and equal dependence class leaving rank_for_schedule to fall through to a LUID that pure C does not control.
